QuestInfo.name: The Alliance Gathers
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart contacted you out of the blue. What's going on?
QuestInfo.1: The regular Alliance meeting is taking place, and for the first time it's not being held in Ereve. Neinheart decided to beef up security to ensure the Empress's safety while she is away from Ereve. Go to the #bStation to Ereve on Victoria Island#k to meet up with the Empress.
QuestInfo.2: The Empress made her way to Victoria Island under the watchful eyes of the Chief Knights. She should be perfectly safe like this...

0.0: #h0#, I have a mission for you. I want you to serve as part of the security detail protecting the Empress at the next alliance meeting.
0.1: Normally, these meetings take place in Ereve, but it has been moved this time.
0.2: The Empress cannot always remain in Ereve... She must learn more about Maple World. That's why I agreed to move the meeting locale.
0.3: But I will not compromise the Empress's safety. Security must be iron clad, understand?

yes.0: The meeting will take place on Victoria Island. You are to protect the Empress from the Station to Ereve all the way until she gets to the meeting place. I will meet you at the platform.

no.0: How did you get to such a high level when your listening comprehension is clearly lacking?
